description: Rotate a workspace file: rename <path> to <path>.1, shift older archives up one slot, drop anything past keep, optionally gzip the new .1. Engine mechanism only — the caller (agent, memory_compactor, whatever) decides which file and when. See docs/concepts/actions.md.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to rotate. Must not contain '..'.

keep.description: Number of rotated archives to retain (.1 through .keep). Anything older is deleted.

compress.description: Compression choice for the newly-rotated .1. Default 'gzip'. Falls back to 'none' if gzip isn't on PATH.
